scope: octopus eight-arm morphology and native idle/walk/run/physical-attack motion are references. Generic radial geometry and suspended swimming adaptation are authored; no native Swim action exists.

adaptation.shape: Generic eight-arm radial octopus with bulbous mantle, paired eyes and tapered arms; cannon mouth and creature markings omitted.
adaptation.motion: Measured global arm pitch, four samples along each chain, fitted periodically for loops and baked to ordinary local joint rotations. Native Walk is adapted to suspended paddling with downward bias and reduced bend. No native Swim clip exists. Native idle and run provide separate curl patterns. Attack is an authored reach informed by the native right-arm physical attack.
adaptation.excluded_reference: dinosaur Squidle is a winged monster with hands; inspected but excluded as an octopus locomotion reference.
